title: Remote measurement and instrumentation laboratory for training in real analog electronic experiments
reason: Engineering description of the Deusto-VISIR remote electronics lab: measurement accuracy and system response times under real student use (404 uses, 10,796 requests). Authors state pedagogical performance is out of scope; no usage indicator is related to student outcomes.
